summary.text: Rodger Broadwater is an independent candidate for Tennessee House of Representatives District 6 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Tim Hicks and Democrat Brad Batt.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a lifelong East Tennessee resident who graduated from North Greene High School in 2014.

paragraphs.text: Broadwater said in a Ballotpedia survey that his campaign would build a public platform where District 6 residents could vote yes or no on major bills, and that he would follow the district's majority position.
He named protecting clean water and opposing the BWXT expansion, capping property taxes, strengthening public schools and lowering healthcare costs among his policy concerns.
